title: Time evolution of impurity models and their universality for quantum computation
summary: Impurity Hamiltonians are systems of $N$ fermionic modes where $O(1)$ of them interact among themselves via quartic (or higher order) fermion terms, while coupling quadratically with $O(N)$ bath modes. Without the quartic interactions, these systems are classically simulable with $O(N^3)$ resources. It was proved that the time-dependent evolution of these systems can perform universal quantum computation.
